pairs.note: Answer correctly names the key person (Matthias Orlev) and the triggering events, but omits the operative consequences in the key: written notice to Limited Partners within five Business Days, each LP's right to redeem as of either of the next two Redemption Dates on 10 days' notice free of lock-up and early redemption charge, and suspension of subscriptions. It also drops the 90-consecutive-day qualifier on incapacity. The remedy is a required element of this provision, so the answer is incomplete.
